summary.en-US: Your chosen sites as big buttons in the sidebar. Click one to load it in the current tab, so one window can move between sites like channels on a TV.

description.en-US:
Siderail shows the sites you choose as big buttons in Firefox's sidebar. Clicking one loads that site in the current tab, so one window and one tab can move between sites like channels on a TV.

A handful of sites get large buttons with the icon above the name; many sites shrink to compact rows. The button for the site in the current tab is highlighted.

Icons are large and sharp. Siderail finds a site's own large icons (its web app manifest, Apple touch icon or SVG icon), or you can upload one, or it shows a coloured letter.

Right-click a button to edit, reorder or remove it. Siderail's options export your list to a file, icons included, to import on another computer.

Permissions: Tabs, to read the current tab's address and load sites into it. Storage, for your list, kept on this computer. Access to websites is optional and asked the first time you add a site: it's only used to download the page you're adding and its icons. Nothing is sent to the developer.
